extracted.name: Salmon Burgers
extracted.description: This recipe uses canned salmon to make this a quick, healthy dinner. Just be sure to get a good quality canned salmon...I like Wild Planet brand pink salmon.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 tsp. each salt, pepper, salt free all purpose seasoning
1/4 tsp. each garlic powder, onion powder, dried dill
instruction_lines: Drain the salmon, place it in a large bowl and flake it with a fork. Add the ground oats, egg, lemon juice and seasonings. Use your hands to mix it up well until everything is incorporated. Shape the mixture into 4 patties and place them onto a plate. Place them in the fridge for 20 or so minutes.

Get a large non-stick skillet and heat the olive oil over medium heat. Pan fry the patties for about 5 or so minutes, until the bottom is golden brown and crispy, then flip and cook until golden brown on the other side. Serve them up in toasted buns with whatever burger toppings sound good to you.
